Austrian crypto firms report €20.4B in H1 volume, topping all of 2025 –
Link
Austria's Financial Market Authority said crypto-asset service providers under its supervision reported €20.4B (~$22.4B) in trading volume in H1 2026, above the €17B for all of 2025. About 74% of user accounts sit in other EEA countries, mainly Germany and France. That cross-border reach adds weight to the European Commission's proposal to give ESMA direct supervision of major CASPs.
Cross-border growth under MiCA is strengthening the case for centralizing EU crypto oversight under ESMA.

Source

tweet.text:
Dear Community, we identified additional order information affected by the August incident which included name, email address, country, order ID, products purchased and payment ID. No shipping addresses, phone numbers, crypto wallet payment addresses, payment card or bank details were involved.

An independent audit has also confirmed no vulnerabilities remain in the affected systems after the fix applied in August.

We are sorry for the concern this may cause. Be wary of phishing emails or letters with false claims of firmware updates, device replacements or similar tactics. Your seed phrase and private keys remain unaffected, and SafePal will never ask for them. Our anti-phishing efforts continue and relevant reports can be submitted at: https://www.safepal.com/scam-protection

Relevant details are updated in the official blog:
https://www.safepal.com/blog/security-update
